description: A10 Wave 7 — 200 Vietlish/interference review candidates. Fresh territory: question formation, existential 'have', time/date expressions, digital-life calques, food & dining, shopping, transportation, comparison & degree, numbers & quantities, direction & movement, negation, politeness & discourse, professional/academic register, false friends, kinship & address terms, redundancy patterns, connector/gerund errors. Deduped vs live(481) + waves 1-6(1065) = 1546-item denylist. Zero collisions.

entries.vietlish: you like eat what?
entries.natural: what do you like to eat?
entries.sourcePattern: thích ăn gì (question word at end)

entries.vietlish: problem is where?
entries.sourcePattern: vấn đề ở đâu (question word at end)

entries.vietlish: you do this with who?
entries.natural: who are you doing this with?
entries.sourcePattern: làm cái này với ai (question word at end)
entries.context: asking about who someone is working with

entries.vietlish: weather today is how?
entries.sourcePattern: hôm nay thời tiết thế nào (adjective question at end)

entries.vietlish: the flight departs at what time?
entries.natural: what time does the flight depart?
entries.sourcePattern: chuyến bay khởi hành lúc mấy giờ (question word at end)
entries.context: asking about a flight departure time

entries.vietlish: inside the box have a gift
entries.natural: there's a gift inside the box
entries.sourcePattern: bên trong hộp có quà (existential calque)
entries.context: describing the contents of a box

entries.vietlish: every 2 day I exercise
entries.sourcePattern: cứ 2 ngày lại tập (frequency expression word order)

entries.vietlish: I will inbox you
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ nhắn tin qua inbox (inbox used as a verb)
entries.context: promising to send a private message

entries.vietlish: I will call video you tonight
entries.sourcePattern: gọi video cho bạn tối nay (calquing gọi video structure)

entries.vietlish: share for me that link
entries.sourcePattern: chia sẻ cái link đó cho tôi (word order calque)
entries.context: asking for a link to be shared

entries.vietlish: this video has too many like
entries.natural: this video has too many likes
entries.sourcePattern: lượt thích (count noun missing plural -s)
entries.context: commenting on a popular video's engagement

entries.vietlish: this dish is too fat
entries.sourcePattern: béo = fatty/greasy (false friend with 'fat' as food adjective)
entries.context: commenting on an oily or greasy dish

entries.vietlish: buy 2 get free 1
entries.sourcePattern: mua 2 tặng 1 (word order calque)

entries.vietlish: this bag is genuine or fake?
entries.natural: is this bag authentic or a fake?
entries.sourcePattern: thật hay giả (genuine vs authentic in product contexts)

entries.vietlish: book a chair on the plane
entries.natural: book a seat on the plane
entries.sourcePattern: đặt ghế trên máy bay (ghế = chair/seat false friend)

entries.vietlish: very very delicious
entries.sourcePattern: ngon lắm lắm (VN adverb reduplication pattern)

entries.vietlish: I am older 3 years than him
entries.natural: I am 3 years older than him
entries.sourcePattern: lớn hơn anh ấy 3 tuổi (degree measure placement calque)

entries.vietlish: this bag is more expensive so much
entries.natural: this bag is much more expensive
entries.sourcePattern: đắt hơn rất nhiều (degree adverb placement after comparative)
entries.context: emphasising that something costs much more

entries.vietlish: I dare to ask you one question
entries.natural: may I ask you a question?
entries.sourcePattern: con/em dám hỏi (self-deprecating honorific calque)
entries.context: politely addressing a question to a senior

entries.vietlish: I hope you will not mind
entries.sourcePattern: tôi hy vọng bạn sẽ không phiền (will not vs don't in polite request)

entries.vietlish: uncle teacher please explain this for us
entries.natural: teacher, could you please explain this for us?
entries.sourcePattern: thầy ơi = kinship address title calqued into English
entries.context: addressing a teacher respectfully in class

entries.vietlish: older sister, where is the bathroom?
entries.natural: excuse me, where is the bathroom?
entries.sourcePattern: chị ơi = addressing a female stranger as older sister
entries.context: asking a stranger politely for directions

entries.vietlish: big brother come help me
entries.natural: excuse me, could you come help me?
entries.sourcePattern: anh ơi = calling a male stranger big brother

entries.vietlish: my older brother him works in Hanoi
entries.natural: my older brother works in Hanoi
entries.sourcePattern: anh tôi ảnh làm việc ở Hà Nội (resumptive pronoun calque)

entries.vietlish: my husband him is very hardworking
entries.sourcePattern: chồng tôi ổng rất chăm chỉ (resumptive pronoun)

entries.vietlish: my mother she likes cooking very much
entries.natural: my mother likes cooking very much
entries.sourcePattern: mẹ tôi bà ấy thích nấu ăn (resumptive pronoun calque)

entries.vietlish: please take care of health
entries.sourcePattern: xin giữ gìn sức khỏe (VN closing formula calqued literally)
entries.context: closing a formal message or letter

entries.vietlish: my grandfather him is 80 years old
entries.sourcePattern: ông tôi ổng 80 tuổi (resumptive pronoun)
entries.context: talking about an elderly relative's age

entries.vietlish: the researcher did the experiment
entries.sourcePattern: làm thí nghiệm vs conduct (register calque in academic writing)
entries.context: describing scientific work in an academic paper

entries.vietlish: the data proves clearly that
entries.sourcePattern: dữ liệu chứng minh rõ ràng rằng (proves vs shows in data contexts)
entries.context: supporting a claim with evidence in a report

entries.vietlish: how strange! I didn't know that
entries.natural: how surprising! / I had no idea!
entries.sourcePattern: lạ thật = 'strange' but conveys 'surprising/unexpected'
entries.context: reacting to unexpected news with surprise

entries.vietlish: please eat fast or we will be late
entries.natural: please eat quickly or we'll be late
entries.sourcePattern: ăn nhanh lên (nhanh = fast, but 'quickly' collocates with eat)

entries.vietlish: he is very active
entries.sourcePattern: năng động = active/energetic (active implies physical movement only in English)

entries.vietlish: the price is including tax already
entries.sourcePattern: giá đã bao gồm thuế rồi (progressive form + word order)
entries.context: clarifying that a quoted price is tax-inclusive

entries.vietlish: advance prepare for the presentation
entries.natural: prepare in advance for the presentation
entries.sourcePattern: chuẩn bị trước cho buổi thuyết trình (adverb-adjective placement calque)

entries.vietlish: the outside temperature is very hot
entries.sourcePattern: nhiệt độ bên ngoài nóng lắm (formal temperature noun structure where simple 'it' sentence is natural)

entries.vietlish: I sympathize with your situation
entries.sourcePattern: tôi thông cảm với hoàn cảnh của bạn (thông cảm = sympathize/understand, over-formal calque)
